title: automation: a flow's successMessage is copied verbatim, so a {{ }} hole naming a run variable reaches the user raw
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cyVSbyvGiXWKxk8GG8

Filing gate: ① user-visible UX defect, `reach:` named producer HotCRM (enrolment screen flow, hotcrm#2371 / hotcrm#2376), and ④ per-layer child of #27381 (row 3).

## Question

Should a flow's `successMessage` (and `errorMessage`) become a template text slot over the run's variables, like a `screen` node's `description` or an `end` node's `message`?

## Reading — `origin/main` bc496bf7, 2026-10-30T10:42Z

Probe: `AutomationEngine.registerFlow` + `execute` of a flow with `successMessage: '{{enrolledCount}} contacts enrolled'` whose one node sets `enrolledCount = 3` (vitest probe in `packages/services/service-automation`, not committed). Output:

```text
{"success":true,"successMessage":"{{enrolledCount}} contacts enrolled","output":{"enrolledCount":3}}
```

- `FlowSchema.successMessage` (`packages/spec/src/automation/flow.zod.ts`) is a plain `z.string()`; its docblock says "`{var}` is NOT interpolated here". It is not one of `FLOW_NODE_TEXT_SLOTS` (`packages/spec/src/automation/flow-text-slot-template.ts`), so no door judges or compiles its holes either.
- The engine copies `flow.successMessage` onto the result unrendered at every terminal exit: `AutomationEngine.execute` (`engine.ts`), `dag-traversal.ts`, `run-resume.ts`.
- The console's `FlowRunner` / `flowResponse.ts` (`ui/packages/app-shell`) shows it verbatim after the `flows.FLOW.successMessage` translation.

## Suspected fix sites

- Contract: type `successMessage`/`errorMessage` as flow text slots (`{{ }}` holes over the run's variables), judged at the same doors as the node text slots — `packages/spec`, `domain:spec`.
- Runtime: render them against the run's variables at each terminal exit before they ride the result — `packages/services/service-automation`, `domain:server`. Open point for whoever builds it: the console translates by key, so the translated sentence must be rendered too (render server-side after translation, or ship the variables).

Lane guess: spec contract first, server render after; triage decides.

## Business reason

A screen flow cannot say "3 contacts enrolled" when it finishes; HotCRM ends its enrolment flow on an extra result screen instead of a toast. An autolaunched flow invoked as an action already reaches the same numbers through the action's `{{ result.output.* }}`, so the two paths answer the same author differently.

Dedupe: semantic search "flow successMessage interpolate run variables template" in objectstack issues, 1 hit (#24546 closed, unrelated resume variables).
